style_analysis.extraction_plan: Create gate-theme.ts in frontend/styles/ to house shared CSSProperties. Use semantic naming: CONTAINER, CARD, TITLE_MAIN, TITLE_SUB, TEXT_DESC, TEXT_HELPER, BTN_PRIMARY, BTN_SECONDARY, BADGE_VARIANTS.

Toast.architecture: Hook-based (useToast) with a shared ToastProvider at the system layout level. Handles success/error/info with automatic dismissal.

progress_integration.current_state: GateTaskStatus already consumes activeTask.progress but UI is basic and lacks transitions.
progress_integration.enhancement: Refine ProgressBar component with CSS transitions, show numerical percentage prominently, and ensure the task message updates reactively. Add 'indeterminate' animation when status is 'running' but progress is null.
progress_integration.websocket_flow: Backend sends TaskEvent via WebSocket; WebSocketContext updates internal state; GateTaskStatus filters for current systemId/gateKey and renders the active task progress.

batch_ux_design.selection_model: Multi-select checkboxes per row/item. State managed locally in the panel (selectedIds: string[]).
batch_ux_design.ui_elements: Select All checkbox in headers/group-titles; Floating BatchActions bar or summary row that appears when count > 0; Loading state for the entire batch operation.

toast_architecture.hook_api: useToast() -> { success(msg), error(msg), info(msg), toasts: Toast[] }.

incremental_steps: 1. Extract gate-theme.ts and implement frontend/components/ui/ primitives.
2. Create useToast hook and ToastProvider; integrate into system-level layout.
3. Upgrade GateTaskStatus to consume progress with better styling.
4. Migrate FigurePlanPanel as a reference/smoke test for the new system.
5. Migrate remaining panels (Analysis, Draft, Manifest, EvidenceMatrix) sequentially.
6. Add batch selection and batch endpoints to Manifest and EvidenceMatrix panels last.
7. Add ConfirmDialogs to destructive/finalizing actions (e.g., Confirm Outline).
